messages:
maya: Morning triage — quick check. Volume: 68 open, 7 new since midnight. Hot tickets: SUP-5821 (embeddings webhook flaky), SUP-5902 (billing duplicate charge), SUP-5910 (dedicated latency spike us-east-1). Anyone grab embedding queue?

jon: grabbing embed queue for the morning. will triage high-importance ones and ping infra if it looks like a cluster issue.

leila: thanks. I'm going to patch the embed macro to add clearer repro steps and a fallback suggestion. Will push PR in 15.

samir: FYI saw two SLO alerts around 03:12 for dedicated nodes — p95 up ~1200ms for a short window. I think autoscaler delayed a bit. Logs show GPU pool scaling event.

evan: noted. Samir can you open a short incident if you need ops to investigate? If it's transient we can include in daily postmortem.

samir: will open ENG-INC-307. linking here once created.

triage-bot: New ticket assigned SUP-5934 -> @jon (low urgency) :eyes:

jon: SUP-5934 acknowledged — low urgency, will reply with workaround.

leila: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/48 — adds macro `embed-fallback` and updates `billing-duplicate` template. Example macro text below for reviewers:

```text
Macro: embed-fallback
Message: "Thanks — we're seeing intermittent embed failures. Quick steps: 1) retry the request, 2) if failures persist, try `model=text-embed-mini-001` as a temporary fallback, 3) include request id and sample input. We're tracking this and will follow up."

Notes: includes ask-for-req-id, suggested fallback model, and internal tag `track:embed-flake`.
```

maya: looks good. can we also add explicit customer-facing phrasing about data privacy (we don't store inputs)? small ask from compliance.

leila: added a one-liner about privacy in the PR.

evan: also update the macro summary used by CS so they don't paste the full internal troubleshooting steps. two variants maybe: public + internal.

leila: done — added `embed-fallback:public` and `embed-fallback:internal`. will merge after one review.

jon: quick status on billing duplicate — I replied to SUP-5902 with the known cause (webhook replays) and a workaround. Customer sent logs; looks like our webhook delivery retries + downstream ack bug. CS might need the `billing-duplicate` macro.

maya: do we have an updated macro for billing?

leila: updated macro snippet in PR for `billing-duplicate` too. sample: "We're sorry — we've detected duplicate charges caused by webhook replay. We're investigating and will refund duplicates automatically where applicable. Could you confirm the transaction id?"

samir: infra notes — autoscaler fix scheduled for today at noon (rollback tuning). If deploy goes well, p95 should stabilize. I'll monitor 12:30-13:00.

evan: assigning monitoring after deploy to @samir and @jon for embedded ticket spikes.

jon: will watch embedding queue and check for repeat failures after autoscaler tweak.

maya: last block — can someone nudge legal to approve the public macro language? I don't want to post without signoff.

evan: I'll ping legal now.

triage-bot: Incident ENG-INC-307 created by samir at 3072102510.

samir: ENG-INC-307: initial notes posted in the incident doc — scaling lag during a burst, tracing to autoscaler cooldown config.

leila: merging macro PR now so CS has draft. tagging @evan for legal review in the PR thread.

maya: thanks team. Afternoon check-in at 15:30 — post any regressions or big customer replies here. :thumbsup:

jon: thanks — will update if anything new pops.

evan: closing the loop later today.
